chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"If you see an old man speaking on the day of Jumu'ah with hadiths of the Jahiliyyah, then throw at his head, even if with pebbles."

key_terms.الشَّيْخَ: an elderly man or elder being referred to in the gathering
key_terms.بِأَحَادِيثِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ: with reports or talk associated with the pre-Islamic age of ignorance
key_terms.فَارْمُوا: then throw; an imperative command to cast something
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, especially in its sacred communal religious setting

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about speaking of Jahiliyyah matters on the day of Jumu'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns occupying the time and sanctity of Jumu'ah with speech rooted in the culture and discourse of Jahiliyyah. It stresses preserving the seriousness of the gathering and rejecting distractions that oppose the religious purpose of the day.
